name: Tacos de Rajas
steps: Char poblanos directly over a flame or under a hot grill until blackened all over.
Cover for 10 minutes, then peel, deseed and cut into strips.
Heat oil in a pan and cook onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add poblano strips and salt; stir for 2 minutes. Lower the heat, fold in sour cream and warm gently without boiling.
Warm tortillas on a dry griddle, fill each with creamy rajas and serve three per person with lime wedges.
tips: Peel only the loose charred skin; rinsing the peppers washes away their smoky flavour.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
